sections.title: Wars and Armed Conflicts

entries.title: Sudanese army advances in Kordofan amid continuing humanitarian catastrophe
entries.development: Financial Times reports Sudanese army gains in Kordofan, reopening supply routes after the El Obeid siege and advancing toward RSF positions. It reports defections and renewed Blue Nile fighting.
entries.significance: Potentially significant territorial and logistical shift in a war with mass displacement and acute hunger.
entries.uncertainty: Territorial and defection accounts depend on reporting and conflict-party sources; ceasefire progress remains limited.

sections.shortfall: Only one sufficiently distinct new conflict development was verified in this edition; prior Ukraine and Gaza developments were already covered.

sections.title: NYC Affairs

entries.title: NYCHA seeks partners to rehabilitate 91 homes for resident purchase
entries.development: NYCHA issued a request for expressions of interest for rehabilitation and resident homeownership involving 91 properties in Queens, Brooklyn and the Bronx under HUD Section 32. Applications open November 19 through February 18, 2027; virtual pre-submission conference December 8.
entries.significance: Creates a concrete development and resident-support partnership opportunity distinct from HCV rental placements.
entries.eventDate: Pre-submission conference December 8, 2026; applications due February 18, 2027
entries.uncertainty: Partner selection and individual resident purchases are not complete.

entries.title: Regional rental construction pipeline projected to expand
entries.development: Reporting on industry projections estimates nearly 39,000 new apartments in the New York metro area during 2026, including more than 13,000 in Brooklyn.
entries.significance: New supply may influence owner outreach and leasing competition, but does not itself establish voucher eligibility.
entries.uncertainty: Forecast covers selected large developments and is not a verified count of completed, available units.

sections.title: Occult Practice & Machine Intuition

entries.title: Uncertainty in Representation Learning on Knowledge Graphs
entries.development: Research thesis distinguishes knowledge, training and predictive uncertainty in knowledge-graph embeddings, using aggregation and conformal methods.
entries.significance: Supports separately tracking evidence uncertainty and model variability in Pattern Sense.
entries.uncertainty: Research results do not validate any IMDO prototype.

entries.title: NoisyCausal tests causal reasoning with structured noise
entries.development: Researchers construct causal graph scenarios with confounding, distractors and incomplete observations and report advantages from explicit graph-guided reasoning.
entries.significance: Useful test suite for Inference Engine and hypothesis verification.
entries.uncertainty: Performance is reported on selected benchmarks.

entries.title: Causal-Audit makes causal reasoning paths explicit
entries.development: Authors propose target-aware graph construction and aggregation of multiple causal paths for auditable intervention reasoning.
entries.significance: Suggests inspectable evidence paths for Second Sight and The Interior.
entries.uncertainty: No independent validation of application to symbolic or divinatory systems.
